fields.summary_ko.0: Major North American and European banks including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley posted strong results (revenue growth YoY) but investment sentiment deteriorating amid 2027 macro volatility and political uncertainty
fields.summary_ko.1: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield declined below 5%; Fed's October rate hold positive factor; but data center financing profitability at multi-billion scale and expectations regarding further hikes questioned
fields.summary_ko.2: Amid 2027 earnings growth normalization and rising specific debt-type risks, U.S. banks show relatively superior private credit exposure, while European banks demonstrate better cash generation and dividend capacity
